name: Turning From The Truth
overview: Scripture reveals that abiding in Christ's word is essential for genuine discipleship, as Jesus declares that continuing in His truth marks true believers (John 8:31). Jesus Himself identifies as the exclusive way to the Father and the embodiment of truth and life (John 14:6), underscoring that turning away from this truth leads to separation from God. The Spirit of truth actively guides believers into all truth, ensuring they remain grounded in God's revelation (John 16:13). Conversely, Romans 1:18 warns that rejecting or suppressing the truth in unrighteousness provokes God's righteous wrath, highlighting the serious consequences of turning from the truth.
